title: Youtubers Plushies
description: This Texture pack makes so you can rename carved pumkins into small plushies of different Minecraft Youtubers
body:
When you're in a world get a carved pumpkin and put it in an anvil, and rename it to get different plushies of different minecraft youtubers you might recognize.

you can check the .txt file to look at the names list and the new names
that come with the updates
